## Entry #1 — 2025-12-20 — BUILD: Initial project structure

**Status**: completed
**Source**: git commits

### What Happened
Created complete monorepo structure with Turborepo, including apps (admin, api, worker) and packages (auth, database, plugins, shared, sms, tokens, ui). Fixed TypeScript build errors and ESLint configuration. Added comprehensive documentation and CI/CD workflows.

### Files Touched
- `apps/admin/` — admin dashboard React app
- `apps/api/` — Hono.js backend API
- `apps/worker/` — worker dashboard React app
- `packages/` — shared packages for auth, database, SMS, tokens, UI
- `turbo.json` — Turborepo configuration
- `package.json` — root package configuration
- `.github/workflows/` — CI/CD workflows
- Documentation files and README

### Why
Established the foundational project architecture to support multi-tenant SaaS development with proper separation of concerns and scalable build system.

### Constitution Notes
- Followed monorepo best practices with clear package boundaries
- Implemented TypeScript strict mode from start
- Set up CI/CD for automated testing and deployment

### Git Commit
`feat: complete monorepo structure with all packages and apps`

## Monthly Summary — December 2025

**Total Entries**: 8

**Features Shipped**: Project structure, dashboard components, plugin architecture, onboarding system
**Bugs Fixed**: 0

**Milestones**: Project foundation complete

### This Month in Plain Language
December 2025 was the foundation month - we built the entire project structure from scratch. Created a proper monorepo with Turborepo, set up all the packages and apps, fixed TypeScript and ESLint issues, and established comprehensive documentation. The focus was on getting the technical foundation solid before building features. Implemented the core plugin architecture and onboarding system to support the MVP features. Ended the month with a clean, production-ready codebase architecture.

### Most Active Files This Month
- `package.json` files across all packages - Setting up dependencies and build configuration
- `apps/admin/` - Building the core admin dashboard interface
- `apps/worker/` - Creating the worker dashboard experience
- `docs/` - Establishing comprehensive documentation foundation
- `.eslintrc.js` and TypeScript configs - Ensuring code quality from the start
